thread:
sre-leah: Heads up — apiserver in eu-central1 spiking CPU and TCP retransmits from provisioner clients. controller-manager lost leader twice. GPU attach backlog rising.
infra-bot: Alert: /apis returning 502/503 from apiserver pool (eu-central1) 09:14 UTC.
infra-max: grabbing netstat from controlplane. seeing many connections in SYN-RECV and retransmits to 10.40.2.8:6443 from 10.36.0.0/16 range.
ops-miguel: paste `ss -s` summary:
```
Total: 256k (kernel 200k maxconn)
TCP:   40000 users; 50000 established; 9000 syn-recv; 8000 time-wait
```
ops-miguel: also seeing `conntrack` entries jump to 95% on cp nodes. dmesg showing NF_CONNTRACK: table full.
infra-max: that would explain SYN backlog and apiserver accept queues filling -> leader election timeouts. provisioner is opening new connection per attach.
platform-zoe: confirmed provisioner client does no connection pooling in the attach path (each attach is a short HTTP call). we can patch to use keep-alive pooled clients.
sre-leah: immediate mitigation: enable temporary conntrack max bump and apply rate-limit on provisioner egress at LB. also rotate controller-manager leader by restarting single replica to clear blocked leader routines.
oncall-bot: @ops-miguel performing a canary restart of controller-manager-eu-0.
ops-miguel: restarted, leader election flipped to controller-manager-eu-1, reconcilers resumed. queued items drained from ~140 -> 25 in 6m.
infra-max: applied `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=300000` and lowered `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` from 432000 -> 120000 as temporary. Watch memory.
platform-zoe: will land PR to provisioner client to reuse connections and exponential backoff for attach retries. ETA 2d.
sre-leah: can we add an apiserver SLO for accept-queue length and alert on syn-recv > 1000?
infra-bot: Created follow-ups: ticket INF-4522 (provisioner connection pooling), INF-4523 (apiserver accept-queue alert), INF-4524 (controlplane autoscale policy for surge windows).
infra-max: long term options: per-client connection limits on LB, move kube-proxy to IPVS to reduce conn churn, and consider horizontal scaling for cp during onboarding events.
platform-zoe: note cost tradeoff: controlplane autoscale adds ~1-2% monthly infra spend during peak windows; pooling reduces CPU and memory without extra nodes.
sre-leah: status — mitigated, 5xx reduced, attach backlog falling. Will write postmortem with timeline and recommended config changes.
ops-miguel: adding short playbook steps: check conntrack, ss -tnp, restart controller-manager, bump conntrack, and throttle provisioner.
platform-zoe: thanks — will coordinate release window for the provisioner patch to avoid another surge. :thumbsup:
